FIBA GDAP: awards

Source: R/fiba_gdap.R
fiba_gdap_awards.Rd

Awards of a competition (MVP, All-Star Five...).

Endpoint: GET https://digital-api.fiba.basketball/hapi/getgdapcompetitionawardsbyid

Usage

fiba_gdap_awards(comp, discipline_format = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

comp

(integer, required) Required. FIBA competition id (GDAP key space), one per edition: competition.competitionId of any game row (208182 = World Cup 2023, 208722 = Paris 2024 men, 208850 = BCL 2024-25). Find it with fiba_gdap_editions or fiba_gdap_games_between.

discipline_format

(character, optional) Optional; the site passes its discipline format. 5x5 answers the same as omitting it (verified on awards and rosters)

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw JSON list.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble (the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE) with the following columns:

col_nametypedescription
competition_idintegerFIBA competition id (GDAP key space): one per edition (2023 World Cup = 208182, BCL 2024-25 = 208850); gdapCompetitionId.
competition_end_datecharacterLast day of the competition, YYYY-MM-DD.
award_datecharacterDate awarded, YYYY-MM-DD.
competition_seasonintegerSeason key, three rules: the END year for club competitions (BCL 2024-25 = 2025) and the event year for national-team events (World Cup 2023 = 2023), both equal to the package season key; qualifiers carry the TARGET tournament year, not the year played (World Cup 2027 qualifiers played in 2025 = 2027, EuroBasket 2029 pre-qualifiers = 2029).
competition_official_namecharacterOfficial name of the competition edition the award was given in.
award_namecharacterAward name (All-Star 5, MVP...).
award_codecharacterAward code (ALLSTAR, MVP...).
award_level_idintegerId of the object the award is attached to: the competitionId when awardLevel is Competition.
award_levelcharacterLevel the award is given at: Competition.
award_labelcharacterExtra label; null in every sample.
player_idintegerFIBA person id, global across competitions and roles (player, coach, official): roster personId = play-by-play pId = game-page P_<id> = gdapPlayerId.
player_first_namecharacterAwarded player's first name.
player_last_namecharacterAwarded player's last name.
player_date_of_birthcharacterAwarded player's date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD.
player_nationalitycharacterAwarded player's nationality, FIBA code.
teamscharacterTeams the awarded player played for in the competition. Stored as a JSON string.

Details

FIBA's terms restrict this source. The GDAP developer-portal terms limit API use to 'Authorized Users' (federations, organisers, FIBA partners) and say any broader use 'is not authorised'; the fiba.basketball terms say no portion of the site may be duplicated, redistributed or manipulated. Users who are not themselves authorised by FIBA should check the terms before using the wrappers.

The GDAP subscription key is public (fiba.basketball ships it in every page); the runtime reads it from the live page at run time and never logs it. Officials' contact details and coaches' and officials' dates of birth are dropped from every body.

Id key spaces: competition_id is one per edition (2023 World Cup = 208182) and game_id is global across competitions (the <gameId> of a game-page URL). team_id is per team per competition (Germany is 279569 at the 2023 World Cup and 281545 at Paris 2024), while organisation_id is the stable federation or club (64 = Germany, every year); the game page's T_<id> and the play-by-play oId are organisation ids, not team ids.

Errors are classed conditions (all inherit hoopR_error): hoopR_no_data when FIBA has nothing (HTTP 404, or GDAP answers {} / [] for an unknown id); hoopR_bad_request for HTTP 400 / 422 or a malformed id, season or date; hoopR_asset_fetch for any other failed fetch or an answer that is not about the request (an error envelope, HTTP 401 after a key refresh, HTTP 500, a body for another game, competition, team, player, federation, family or season). Seasons are FIBA's own key, which equals the sdv key: the END year for club competitions, the event year for national-team events, the target tournament year for qualifiers.

 fiba_gdap_awards(comp = 208182)
